# Elmira Heating & Cooling

> Elmira Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Elmira, Waterloo Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 669-4738  |  Email: contact@elmiraheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://elmiraheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Elmira, Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
